categories.main_business_segments: Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. (ADS) operates through three primary reportable segments: Pipe, Infiltrator, and International. The Pipe segment manufactures and markets thermoplastic corrugated pipe in the United States. Infiltrator focuses on plastic leachfield chambers, septic tanks, and accessories for onsite septic wastewater treatment, primarily in residential applications. The International segment covers manufacturing and sales outside the U.S., including Canada, Mexico, and South America, while Allied Products & Other encompasses complementary water management products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: ADS leverages advanced extrusion and molding technologies to produce high-performance thermoplastic corrugated pipes (HDPE and PP), injection-molded chambers, tanks, and fittings. The company utilizes proprietary production equipment and processes, including continuous extrusion, blow molding, and injection molding, with a strong emphasis on incorporating recycled materials. ADS also operates a significant recycling program, converting post-consumer and post-industrial plastics into new products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves approximately 16,000 customers, primarily through distributors, national and independent waterworks distributors, buying groups, co-ops, and major retailers. Key end markets include non-residential, residential, infrastructure, and agriculture construction, as well as rural communities requiring onsite septic solutions. Major customers include Ferguson Enterprises and Core and Main, which together accounted for over 25% of net sales in fiscal 2023.
categories.geographic_coverage: ADS has a broad geographic footprint with 66 manufacturing plants and 40 distribution centers across the United States, Canada, Mexico, and South America. The company also has a presence in Europe and the Middle East through subsidiaries and joint ventures. The majority of sales are in North America, but international operations are growing, particularly in Canada, Mexico, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: ADS operates primarily as a midstream and downstream manufacturer, converting raw materials (virgin and recycled resins) into finished water management products and distributing them through a network of distributors and retailers. The company is also vertically integrated in recycling, sourcing and processing recycled plastics for use in its manufacturing operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the use of recycled materials, investing in automation and manufacturing technology, and broadening the product portfolio through innovation and acquisitions. ADS is focused on sustainability, regulatory advocacy, and developing engineered solutions for water management challenges. The company is building a new Engineering & Technology Center to drive innovation in product engineering, material science, and manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: ADS generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products, including pipes, chambers, tanks, and allied water management products. Sales are made to distributors, retailers, buying groups, co-ops, and direct customers, with revenue recognized upon delivery. The company also distributes complementary products through resale agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ADS is the leading national manufacturer in a highly fragmented industry, competing with regional and local producers of concrete, steel, PVC, and HDPE pipes. Its main competitive advantages are its national footprint, broad product offering, engineering support, and ability to deliver complete water management solutions. ADS is the only corrugated HDPE pipe producer with a national presence in the U.S., giving it a strong market leadership position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2023, ADS reported net sales of $3.07 billion, a 10.9% increase year-over-year, with net income of $511 million and adjusted EBITDA of $904 million (29.4% margin). The company has demonstrated strong growth in both revenue and profitability, supported by pricing, product mix, and expansion in core and allied products. ADS maintains a robust balance sheet with significant liquidity and a leverage ratio of 1.2x.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ADS differentiates itself through its comprehensive, engineered water management solutions that span the entire lifecycle of stormwater, from capture to treatment. Its products are lighter, more durable, cost-effective, and easier to install than traditional materials, with a strong emphasis on sustainability and recycled content. The company’s national scale, technical expertise, and ability to provide complete systems offer significant value to customers and set it apart from regional competitors.
